# datadog-cli

> CLI for querying Datadog APIs and managing notebooks. Covers logs, traces, APM, metrics, hosts, monitors, dashboards, SLOs, incidents, RUM, audit, usage, and more. Supports notebook write operations (create, update, delete).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Installation, quick start, all command groups, output format examples, configuration, supported sites
- [Skill](skill/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill with examples, auth setup, output flags, time formats, global flags reference
- [Commands Reference](skill/reference/commands.md): Complete flag reference for every command and subcommand, required API scopes

## API

Most commands are read-only (list/get/search/aggregate). Write operations are supported for notebooks (create, update, delete) and require `notebooks_write` scope.

Authentication via `DD_API_KEY` + `DD_APP_KEY` environment variables, `--api-key`/`--app-key` flags, or `~/.datadog-cli/config.yaml` (profile-based).

Default site: `datadoghq.com`. Override with `DD_SITE` env var or `--site` flag.

## Command Groups

logs, traces, apm, metrics, monitors, hosts, containers, processes, dashboards, events, downtimes, incidents, notebooks (list, get, create, update, delete), rum, slos, tags, audit, usage, users, pipelines, api-keys, auth

## Key Flags

- `--json` / `-j`: raw JSON output
- `--plaintext` / `-p`: no color, no borders
- `--limit` / `-l`: max results (default 100)
- `--jq EXPR`: apply jq expression to JSON output
- `--fields f1,f2`: show only named columns
- `--from` / `--to`: time range (relative like `1h`, ISO-8601, or unix seconds)
- `--profile`: named profile from config file

## Notebook Write Commands

```bash
# Create an annotated incident investigation notebook
datadog-cli notebooks create \
  --name "Apr 7 Karpenter Cascade" \
  --metric "avg:karpenter.cluster_state.node_count{*}" \
  --start "2026-04-07 07:00" --end "2026-04-08 17:00" \
  --hline "175:ok dashed:Pre-incident baseline" \
  --hline "130:error dashed:Post-eviction baseline" \
  --vline "2026-04-07 11:31:error bold" \
  --note "## Timeline\n\n- 11:31 AM: Mass eviction (-33 nodes)"
# => https://app.datadoghq.com/notebook/12345678/apr-7-karpenter-cascade

# Update a notebook (full PUT replacement — unspecified cells are removed)
datadog-cli notebooks update 12345678 --name "New Name"

# Delete a notebook (--confirm required)
datadog-cli notebooks delete 12345678 --confirm
```

`--hline "VALUE:DISPLAY_TYPE[:LABEL]"` — horizontal marker at a y-axis value (repeatable).
`--vline "DATETIME:DISPLAY_TYPE[:LABEL]"` — vertical marker at a timestamp (repeatable); datetime is `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"` PT.
`--live-span` — relative window (e.g. `1h`, `4h`, `1d`); alternative to `--start`/`--end`.

Required scope for write commands: `notebooks_write`.

## Skill Management

```bash
datadog-cli skill add    # install to ~/.claude/skills/datadog-cli/
datadog-cli skill print  # print SKILL.md to stdout
```
